CCP_state_rebuild = {
	clear_array = ccp_state_all
	every_state = {
		ROOT = { add_to_array = { array = ccp_state_all value = PREV } }
	}
	set_variable = { ccp_state_count = ccp_state_all^num }
	CCP_state_recount_pages = yes
	set_variable = { ccp_state_page = 0 }
	CCP_state_load_page = yes
}

CCP_state_recount_pages = {
	set_variable = { ccp_state_pages_last = ccp_state_count }
	subtract_from_variable = { ccp_state_pages_last = 1 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ccp_state_pages_last min = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ccp_page_remainder = ccp_state_pages_last }
	modulo_temp_variable = { ccp_page_remainder = 14 }
	subtract_from_variable = { ccp_state_pages_last = var:ROOT.ccp_page_remainder }
	divide_variable = { ccp_state_pages_last = 14 }
}

CCP_state_load_page = {
	clear_array = ccp_state_page_items
	set_variable = { ccp_state_page_shown = ccp_state_page }
	add_to_variable = { ccp_state_page_shown = 1 }
	set_variable = { ccp_state_pages_shown = ccp_state_pages_last }
	add_to_variable = { ccp_state_pages_shown = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ccp_page_first = var:ROOT.ccp_state_page }
	multiply_temp_variable = { ccp_page_first = 14 }
	set_temp_variable = { ccp_page_last = var:ROOT.ccp_page_first }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ccp_page_last = 13 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = ccp_state_count
		value = ccp_slot
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = ccp_slot value = ccp_page_first compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { var = ccp_slot value = ccp_page_last compare = less_than_or_equals }
			}
			add_to_array = {
				array = ccp_state_page_items
				value = ccp_state_all^ccp_slot
			}
		}
	}
	CCP_mark_dirty = yes
}

CCP_state_next_page = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_state_page < ccp_state_pages_last }
		}
		add_to_variable = { ccp_state_page = 1 }
		CCP_state_load_page = yes
	}
}

CCP_state_prev_page = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ccp_state_page > 0 }
		}
		subtract_from_variable = { ccp_state_page = 1 }
		CCP_state_load_page = yes
	}
}

	ROOT = { set_variable = { ccp_state = PREV } }

	}
	set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 10 }
	CCP_mark_dirty = yes
}
